High performance FDTD solver for EM waves

FDTD solver for electromagnetic waves, parallelized with OpenMP, MPI, and implemented in CUDA.

This project was realized for the class INFO0939-1 - High performance scientific computing at the University of Liège, in collaboration with Loïc Delbarre. The code is available on Github.

While FDTD schemes are a simple and well-known way to simulate electromagnetic waves, they are a good way to learn high-performance computing. In this project, the code was parallelized with OpenMP, MPI, and a CUDA version was implemented, in both 2D and 3D versions. The solver was run on Nic5, the computing cluster of the ULiège.
